children: (“ZJK” or the “Company”), a high-tech precision parts and hardware manufacturer serving artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, consumer electronics, electric vehicles, aerospace, and other smart technologies, today announced key operational progress in its aerospace precision fastener business of obtaining EN9100:2018 certification.

After meeting stringent aerospace standards for structural reliability and precision, ZJK’s subsidiary, ZhongKe Precision Components (Guangdong) Co. Ltd. (“Guangdong Subsidiary”), has obtained a certification of its aerospace quality management system under EN 9100:2018, a standard technically equivalent to AS 9100D and JISQ 9100:2016. Guangdong Subsidiary has established an end-to-end technical system across material selection, process design, precision machining, inspection, and validation. Leveraging its expertise in high-performance materials, including titanium alloys and superalloys, ZJK has made progress in relevant customer validation and related supply processes, laying a solid foundation for future volume ramp-up. The resources of Guangdong Subsidiary can also be drawn on to support ZJK’s Sichuan manufacturing base in aerospace manufacturing.

ZJK’s management stated, “Aerospace represents an attractive growth opportunity alongside our AI infrastructure business. Rigorous qualification standards create high entry barriers in aerospace fasteners. With EN 9100-certified capabilities in Guangdong and expertise in high-performance materials, we are well equipped to deepen customer collaborations and pursue future opportunities across the commercial space and low-altitude aviation markets.”

is a high-tech precision parts and hardware manufacturer serving artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, consumer electronics, electric vehicles, aerospace, and other smart technologies. With over 15 years in the precision metal parts manufacturing industry, the Company maintains a skilled engineering team, highly automated CNC and precision manufacturing equipment, a diversified global customer base, and comprehensive quality management systems. ZJK mainly offers precision screws and nuts, high-strength bolts, turning and stamping parts, CNC machining and milling parts, high-precision structural components, and miniature Surface Mounting Technology (SMT) packaging.
